headline: Growth continues but a non-cash charge dents GAAP earnings
summary_short: Ryan Specialty's Q2 2026 revenue rose 7.2% y/y to $916.6M on 6.7% organic growth, but GAAP net income fell 18.6% y/y to $42.3M ($0.33 diluted EPS) after a $17.6M contingent-consideration remeasurement charge, even as Adjusted EBITDAC grew 6.0% and Adjusted diluted EPS rose to $0.74 from $0.66.
summary_long: Revenue grew 7.2% y/y to $916.6M on $53.7M of organic growth (rate 6.7%, down from 7.1%) plus $11.0M from acquisitions, partly offset by softer property rates and lower contingent commissions. Adjusted EBITDAC rose 6.0% to $326.9M though margin slipped 40bp to 35.7%. GAAP net income fell 18.6% y/y to $42.3M ($0.33 diluted EPS) after a $17.6M contingent-consideration remeasurement charge (vs a $0.8M credit a year ago) tied to higher loss ratios at US Assure; Adjusted net income still rose 7.6% to $198.7M and Adjusted diluted EPS rose to $0.74 from $0.66. Cash fell to $140.1M; long-term debt rose to $3.57B. No 2026 guidance given in this 10-Q.
